Wayfinding and signage refresh for a zone
Relocate one machine
rationale: Hold far below configured setting in both halves of the period (survives 10% FDR).
Z-B40 has the lowest coin-in/hr on the floor and fell further while walkway W-ENT-B40 was closed (Mar 3 - Apr 7).

Controlled location test: swap 3 of our low-effect machines in busier spots with 3 of the manager's quiet-spot machines. Settles whether play follows the spot before paying to replace machines in quiet spots.
measurement: Technician verifies the paytable/config against game_math; then compare 30-day hold to configured.
Z-B40 share of floor coin-in and zone traffic, 20 live days vs. the prior 30 (difference-in-differences vs. Z-BAR).

Pooled slope of log play change on log spot change over 6 moves, each against a matched unmoved machine in the same bank, over the first 16 operating days after the move. Planned 90% CI on the slope about +/-0.14.
uncertainty: Inspection is information: it may confirm a config difference or find nothing (low = $0).
Signage lift of 2-10% of zone theo is an assumption, not estimated from this data.
Theo range uses the natural-experiment slope and its 90% CI. The manager's quiet-spot machines are low hold, so a swap gains less theo than play.
